ideas.children_he: ה׳ בּוֹחֵר בִּבְצַלְאֵל לְהוֹבִיל אֶת הַבְּנִיָּה וְנוֹתֵן לוֹ כִּשָּׁרוֹן לַעֲבֹד בְּמַתֶּכֶת, בָּאֶבֶן וּבָעֵץ. אָהֳלִיאָב וּבַעֲלֵי מְלָאכָה נוֹסָפִים יַעַזְרוּ לוֹ.
ideas.children_en: God tells Moses that Bezalel is chosen and filled with divine spirit, wisdom, understanding, and skill in metalwork, stonework, and woodwork. Oholiab and other skilled artisans join him. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: בַּעֲלֵי הַמְּלָאכָה יָכִינוּ אֶת הָאוֹהֶל וְכָל כֵּלָיו. הֵם יָכִינוּ גַּם בִּגְדֵי כֹּהֲנִים, שֶׁמֶן מְיֻחָד וּקְטֹרֶת רֵיחָנִית.
ideas.children_en: God lists the sacred works the artisans must make: the Tabernacle, ark, cover, holy vessels, table, lampstand, altars, basin, priestly garments, anointing oil, and incense. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: שַׁבָּת הִיא יוֹם מְנוּחָה קָדוֹשׁ, וְלֹא עוֹבְדִים בָּהּ. הִיא מַזְכִּירָה אֶת הַבְּרִית עִם ה׳ וְאֶת מְנוּחָתוֹ אַחֲרֵי בְּרִיאַת הָעוֹלָם.
ideas.children_en: God commands Israel to keep the Sabbath as holy. Six days are for work, while the seventh is a day of rest, an everlasting covenant sign recalling God’s rest after creation. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: כְּשֶׁה׳ מְסַיֵּם לְדַבֵּר עִם מֹשֶׁה, הוּא נוֹתֵן לוֹ שְׁנֵי לוּחוֹת אֶבֶן. עֲשֶׂרֶת הַדִּבְּרוֹת כְּתוּבִים עֲלֵיהֶם.
ideas.children_en: When God finishes speaking with Moses on Mount Sinai, He gives him two stone tablets of testimony written by the finger of God. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.
